responsibility: This header declares the DynamicStrings-oriented file I/O wrapper API in the mc-boot runtime. It exports existence tests, open routines, whole-string writes, and line reads that use DynamicStrings_String for filenames and content, defining the high-level string façade over the lower-level FIO subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration half of GSFIO: it exports the DynamicStrings-based file I/O wrapper API, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GSFIO.cc contains the actual bridging code to the underlying FIO routines.
